user.title: Connect your Grill BT5.0 thermometer
user.description: Disconnect any phone apps using the thermometer. Enable device connections on your Bluetooth proxy. BF-30 is tested; other Grill BT5.0 models require verification.

error.invalid_address: Enter an address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF

abort.unsupported_device: This device does not advertise the BT5 service

init.title: Temperature display
init.description: Choose the display unit for all probes. Home Assistant converts the readings; the thermometer display is unchanged. You can also choose a unit for each sensor in its entity settings.
